development_firewall.rule: 2025H1 is excluded from development evaluation because its outcomes have already informed this design.

development_gates.scope: A horizon passes independently. Failure of one output cannot be offset by another output’s success.

direction.name: always-majority class
direction.formula: Predict the majority class learned from the training block for every row.

direction.name: last-five-minute sign
direction.formula: Predict direction from the sign of the last-five-minute return.

direction.name: multinomial linear model
direction.formula: Multinomial linear classifier fit only on each fold’s training block.

direction.name: frozen v0 LightGBM architecture retrained on identical rows
direction.formula: The frozen v0 LightGBM direction architecture retrained on identical rows.

magnitude.name: 30-minute time-bucket scale
magnitude.formula: median_train(u_h | time bucket) * s_h,t, with global-median fallback

baselines.selection_rule: Best baseline means the lowest OOS MAE among this fixed set. No baseline is selected using calibration or final outcomes. All baseline parameters are learned only from each fold’s training block.

bootstrap.purpose: Uncertainty uses a 2,000-draw paired session-block bootstrap.

evaluation_anchors.full_minute_decisions: All valid minute decisions, for v0 comparability.

non_overlapping.rule: Non-overlapping decisions anchored at 09:30 and every H minutes thereafter.

evaluation_anchors.daily_ic: Daily IC uses the full minute sample because H60 produces too few non-overlapping observations per day for a stable within-day rank.

final_test_protocol.burned_test_note: The 2025H1 test is burned. It cannot be called untouched again and must not determine v1 promotion.
final_test_protocol.historical_training_note: Using 2025H1 for final training/calibration is allowed only because it is explicitly reclassified as known historical data. It must not receive a v1 test score.
unseal_preconditions: registration and source hashes are frozen
the exact V1-C candidate is fixed
no final-test values have been inspected
the access/unseal is recorded in the manifest
final_test_protocol.final_comparison: The frozen v0 comparator and V1-C may be evaluated together as one pre-registered final protocol.
